Air India Flight AI-171 Crash Probe Finds No Fuel Switch Fault

An investigation into the crash of Air India flight AI-171 has concluded that there was no fault found in the fuel control switch. The Centre informed Parliament that the examination of the complete thrust control module is nearing its final stage. This finding pertains to the fuel switch lock of the grounded Boeing 787 Dreamliner.
